title: Inducible HIV-1 Reservoir Reduction Assay (HIVRRA) for Testing Cure Strategies
author: Jade Jansen
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: TZM-BL (NIH AIDS Reagent program, catalog number: 8129); 2 × 10 6 cells are required for each condition (compounds or untreated) tested

PBMCs from uninfected donors (obtained from blood donors from the Dutch national blood bank in Amsterdam, the Netherlands); 8.2 × 10 5 cells are required for each condition (compounds or untreated) tested
PBMCs from PWH on ART (obtained from Amsterdam Cohort Studies on HIV infection and AIDS); 8.2 × 10 5 cells are required for each condition (compounds or untreated) tested Reagents
Newborn calf serum (NBCS) (ThermoFisher Scientific, catalog number:
FetalClone II serum (FCS) Cytiva HyClone TM (Fisher Scientific, catalog number:
Iscove’s modified Dulbecco’s medium (IMDM) (ThermoFisher Scientific, catalog number:
Penicillin-Streptomycin (Pen Strep) (ThermoFisher Scientific, catalog number: 15140122), 10,000 U/mL penicillin/10,000 μg/mL streptomycin
Protease inhibitor Saquinavir (MedChemExpress, catalog number: HY-17007), 10 mM in DMSO
RQ1 RNase-free DNAse (Promega, catalog number: M6101), 1,000 U/mL
CellTrace TM Violet (ThermoFisher Scientific, catalog number: C34557 )
Na 2 H 2 P 2 O 7 (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number:
Tris-H 3 PO 4 (Trizma ® phosphate monobasic) (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number:

steps.title: Prepare PHA stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 mg lyophilized PHA in 10 mL IMDM to obtain 200 µg/mL; aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 % HCl solution
steps.instruction: Add 2.7 mL 37 % HCl to 1 000 mL Milli‑Q water, mix, store at room temperature; handle as corrosive acid in a fume hood.

steps.title: Prepare ciprofloxacin stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 mg ciprofloxacin in 2.5 mL 0.1 % HCl (Recipe 2) to 2 mg/mL; aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare IL‑2 stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 30 000 IU recombinant human IL‑2 in 15 mL IMDM to 2 000 U/mL; aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare thaw medium
steps.instruction: Mix 400 mL IMDM with 100 mL 20 % NBCS; keep at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare cell line medium
steps.instruction: Combine 450 mL IMDM, 50 mL 10 % FCS, 5 mL 100 U/mL penicillin/100 µg/mL streptomycin, 1.25 mL 5 µg/mL ciprofloxacin (Recipe 3); store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare complete medium
steps.instruction: Combine 450 mL IMDM, 50 mL 10 % FCS, 5 mL 100 U/mL penicillin/100 µg/mL streptomycin, 1.25 mL 5 µg/mL ciprofloxacin (Recipe 3), and 0.5 mL 20 IU/mL IL‑2 (Recipe 4); store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare complete medium + protease inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL 10 µM Saquinavir to complete medium (Recipe 7) immediately before use; mix well.

steps.title: Prepare complete medium + protease inhibitor + DNAse
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL DNase (1 000 U/mL) to 10 mL of complete medium + protease inhibitor (Recipe 8); mix and use fresh.

steps.title: Prepare PHA medium with protease inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL 1 µg/mL PHA (Recipe 1) to complete medium + protease inhibitor (Recipe 8); store at 4 °C and mix before use.

steps.title: Prepare 10 M NaOH solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 40 g NaOH, dissolve in small portions of 150 mL Milli‑Q water, then bring volume to 250 mL with Milli‑Q water; store at room temperature; handle as corrosive.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Tris‑H₃PO₄ pH 7.8
steps.instruction: Dissolve 21.9 g Trizma phosphate monobasic in 60 mL Milli‑Q water, adjust pH to 7.8 with 10 M NaOH, bring volume to 100 mL with Milli‑Q water; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 25 % Triton X‑100
steps.instruction: Dilute 25 mL Triton X‑100 with 75 mL Milli‑Q water; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M DTT solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 154.2 mg DTT in 0.5 mL Milli‑Q water; store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M MgCl₂ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9.522 g MgCl₂ in 80 mL Milli‑Q water, bring volume to 100 mL with Milli‑Q water; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM disodium pyrophosphate
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.1097 g Na₂H₂P₂O₇ in 100 mL Milli‑Q water; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM ATP solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 275.6 mg ATP in 10 mL Milli‑Q water; aliquot 250 µL, store at –20 °C (single‑use).

steps.title: Prepare Pre‑LAR solution (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 2.25 mL 1 M Tris‑H₃PO₄ (pH 7.8) (Recipe 12) to 38.9 mM, 22.5 mL 100 % glycerol to 0.39 %, 6 mL 25 % Triton X‑100 (Recipe 13) to 0.03 %, 50 µL 1 M DTT (Recipe 14) to 2.6 µM, and 19.2 mL Milli‑Q water; total volume 50 mL.

steps.title: Prepare Pre‑LAR + D‑Luciferin (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Add 33.33 mg D‑Luciferin to 50 mL Pre‑LAR to obtain 0.83 mM final concentration.

steps.title: Prepare LAR substrate per 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: For each plate combine 1.6 mL Pre‑LAR, 56 µL 1 M MgCl₂ (final 18.7 mM), 325 µL Milli‑Q water, 4.67 µL 50 mM Na₂H₂P₂O₇ (final 0.78 µM), 50 µL 50 mM ATP (final 0.83 mM), and 1 mL Pre‑LAR + D‑Luciferin; keep on ice and use immediately.

steps.title: Thaw PBMCs from PWH (Day 1)
steps.instruction: Thaw required vials of PWH PBMCs in a 37 °C water bath, transfer to 50 mL tube, add 35 mL cold thaw medium (Recipe 5) dropwise while swirling, rest 10 min at RT, centrifuge 400 × g 10 min RT, aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL complete medium + protease inhibitor + DNAse (Recipe 9); if cell count >20 × 10⁶, add more complete medium, loosen tube caps for gas exchange, incubate 37 °C 2 h, centrifuge 400 × g 10 min RT, remove supernatant, resuspend in 1 mL complete medium + protease inhibitor (Recipe 8).

steps.title: Count viable PBMCs
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 µL cell suspension with 90 µL PBS (1:10), add 10 µL trypan blue, load 10 µL into TC20 counting slide (range 5 × 10⁴–1 × 10⁷ cells/mL), record live cell number; ensure viability > 75 %.

steps.title: Plate PBMCs for HIVRRA
steps.instruction: For each condition (compound or untreated) pipette 8.2 × 10⁵ PBMCs into a well of a 24‑well plate, add test compound or solvent control, adjust volume to 500 µL with complete medium, add protease inhibitor; include untreated and solvent‑only controls.

steps.title: Culture PBMCs (Day 1‑3)
steps.instruction: Incubate plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified incubator for 2 days; note that work with PWH PBMCs must be performed in BSL‑3.

steps.title: Thaw and label healthy‑donor PBMCs (Day 3)
steps.instruction: Thaw required vials of healthy‑donor PBMCs (or use fresh), transfer to 50 mL tube, add 35 mL cold thaw medium (Recipe 5) dropwise while swirling, rest 10 min RT, centrifuge 400 × g 10 min RT, resuspend pellet in 35 mL RT PBS, centrifuge 400 × g 10 min RT, resuspend in 1 mL PBS, count as in step 9, dilute to 10 × 10⁶ cells/mL with PBS, prepare CTV labeling solution by diluting 1 µL CTV in 5 mL PBS (or proportionally for >50 × 10⁶ cells), add ~0.5 mL diluted CTV to cell suspension, pipette up/down 5× with 1 mL pipette to achieve 10 × 10⁶ cells/mL, add 2.5 µL DNase per mL, incubate 37 °C 20 min protected from light, keep labeled cells protected from light thereafter, add 5× volume of complete culture medium (RT) (Recipe 7), mix, incubate RT 5 min, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, remove supernatant, resuspend in 15 mL complete culture medium (RT) (Recipe 7), centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1–2 mL pre‑warmed complete culture medium, incubate RT 10 min, count cells as in step 9, adjust to 1.64 × 10⁶ cells/mL with complete culture medium.

steps.title: Stimulate PWH PBMCs with PHA (B1)
steps.instruction: Collect Day 1 24‑well plate PBMCs into sterile 1.5‑2 mL Eppendorf tubes (one per well), add 0.82 × 10⁶ CTV‑stained healthy‑donor PBMCs (0.5 mL) per well, centrifuge 250 × g 10 min, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL pre‑warmed PHA medium with protease inhibitor (Recipe 10), transfer to a new 24‑well plate, take 120 µL of each well (≈98 400 CTV⁺ cells) into separate 1.5 mL tubes for cytotoxicity analysis, return remaining cells to humidified incubator 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 2 days.

steps.title: Determine cytotoxicity by flow cytometry (B2)
steps.instruction: To each 120 µL PBMC mixture, add 1 mL PBS, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, aspirate supernatant, resuspend in 1 mL PBS, centrifuge again 400 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, add 50 µL FluoroFix™ buffer, incubate RT ≥15 min, transfer to FACS tubes, acquire on flow cytometer (405 nm laser, 450/50 filter) to measure CTV⁺ (healthy donor) vs CTV⁻ (PWH) populations, calculate %CTV⁻ in test condition relative to untreated to obtain cytotoxicity percentage.

steps.title: Prepare TZM‑BL cells (Day 4)
steps.instruction: For each 96‑well plate, prepare 10 mL cell line medium (Recipe 6) containing 2 × 10⁶ TZM‑BL cells, dispense 100 µL per well into all wells except columns 12 E‑H (add 100 µL medium only for background), incubate overnight 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified.

steps.title: Co‑culture PBMCs with TZM‑BL (Day 5)
steps.instruction: Collect Day 3 24‑well co‑culture tubes, centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend each condition in 1.32 mL complete medium (Recipe 7) pre‑warmed 37 °C (contains ~720 000 CTV⁺ healthy donor PBMCs and matching CTV⁻ PWH PBMCs), count cells as in step 9 to confirm density, aim for 60 000 CTV⁺ + 60 000 CTV⁻ per well (total 120 000 cells per 110 µL).

steps.title: Serially dilute PBMCs in V‑bottom plate
steps.instruction: Add 110 µL complete medium to each well of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate, add 110 µL cell suspension to wells A1‑A11 (A12 receives medium only). Transfer 110 µL from row A to row B, mix, then from B to C, and continue sequentially through rows C‑H, discarding the final 110 µL from row H. This creates an 11‑step, 2‑fold serial dilution across rows A‑H.

steps.title: Add diluted PBMCs to TZM‑BL plate
steps.instruction: Resuspend each dilution well, transfer 100 µL from every well of the V‑bottom plate onto the corresponding wells of the white 96‑well plate containing TZM‑BL cells (plate layout as in Figure 2), delivering PBMC numbers ranging from ~30 000 down to 234 per well.

steps.title: Incubate co‑culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the co‑culture plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified incubator for 4 days.

steps.title: Prepare fresh LAR substrate (Day 9)
steps.instruction: Just before assay, make LAR substrate as described in Recipe 20 and keep protected from light.

steps.title: Perform luciferase assay
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL LAR substrate to each well of the TZM‑BL plate using a 12‑channel multichannel pipette, immediately read luminescence on a luminometer (0.5 s integration per well). Export data to Excel for analysis.

description: Validation of protocol The HIVRRA uses a large number of replicates (11) to ensure precision and to measure smaller differences between the test conditions (compounds or untreated). Also, the use of an 8-fold titration enhances the reliability of the results, providing greater confidence in detecting smaller differences between the compounds (see Data analysis). Compounds should be tested on PBMCs from a sufficient number of PWH to obtain reliable results and account for donor variation. Untreated conditions and solvent-only controls should be included in each experiment. Viral reservoir size is calculated using the percentage of RLU calculated based on the minimum and maximum RLU per plate rather than the raw RLU data. This limits plate-to-plate variations as each condition is measured in a separate plate, and the RLU is influenced by the time between the addition of the luciferase substrate and the luminescence measurement. This protocol (or parts of it) has been used and validated in the following research articles: Jansen et al. [13]. Noncanonical-NF-κB activation and DDX3 inhibition reduces the HIV-1 reservoir by elimination of latently infected cells ex-vivo. Microbiol Spectr ( Figures 3 and 4). Vlaming et al. [12]. Synergistic Activity of Second Mitochondrial-Derived Activator of Caspases Mimetic with Toll-like Receptor 8 Agonist Reverses HIV-1-Latency and Enhances Antiviral Immunity. Int J Mol Sci. (Figure 4).
